definition.simple: A mixture where the particles are big enough to be seen and will eventually settle down to the bottom if left undisturbed.
definition.academic: A heterogeneous mixture containing solid particles that are sufficiently large for sedimentation.

common_misconceptions: Suspensions are permanent. (Correction: No, suspensions are unstable. The particles settle down when left undisturbed.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask: If you shake a bottle of muddy water and leave it on the table, what happens after 10 minutes?
